div.div:
طَلَاقٌ رَجْعِىٌّ , and رِجْعِىٌّ, (assumed tropical:) A divorce in which one reserves to himself the right of returning to his wife, or restoring her to himself, or taking her back to the marriage-state. (Mgh, * Msb.) ―
-b2- رَجْعِىٌّ applied to a beast: see رَجِيعُ سَفَرٍ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
